{{Vanilla|Leaves}}
{{Infobox auto|Oak Leaves|title=Leaves}}
'''Leaves''' are the foliage blocks of trees. In Matcha Flavoured, broken leaves no longer drop saplings or sticks; saplings are crafted from leaves instead, and oak and dark oak leaves drop [[apple]]s more often than in vanilla.

== Obtaining ==
Leaves drop themselves when broken with [[shears]] or a {{MCW|Silk Touch}} tool, as in vanilla.

== Drops ==
Broken without shears or Silk Touch, leaves drop nothing except apples from oak and dark oak leaves.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/spruce_leaves.json}}</ref> The pack removed sapling and stick drops from every kind of leaves to reduce inventory clutter.<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.5-alpha|quote=Leaves no longer drop saplings or sticks, saplings are made from crafting instead (this was done to minimise inventory clutter)}}</ref>

=== Apples ===
Oak and dark oak leaves roll twice for an [[apple]], once for [[Fortune]] and once for the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] tool intrinsic. Each roll uses the same chances:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/oak_leaves.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/dark_oak_leaves.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable"
! Enchantment level !! Chance per roll !! Vanilla
|-
| None || 0.75% || 0.5%
|-
| I || 0.9% || 0.56%
|-
| II || 1.5% || 0.63%
|-
| III || 2% || 0.83%
|-
| IV or higher || 4% || 2.5%
|}
With no enchantment both rolls use the base chance, so an unenchanted tool has two 0.75% chances per block. The apples come from the pack's own apple loot table, so they carry the pack's apple properties.

The 1.12.1-alpha notes describe the change as "base 0.5% -> 0.75% ; max fortune 2.5% -> 4%". The 4% chance applies at level IV or higher; Fortune III gives 2%.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=Apple drop rate is now higher than vanilla (base 0.5% -> 0.75% ; max fortune 2.5% -> 4%)}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Saplings ===
Every kind of leaves can be crafted into one of its sapling (for mangrove leaves, a propagule; for azalea and flowering azalea leaves, the matching azalea).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/oak_sapling_from_oak_leaves.json}}</ref> Each recipe unlocks when the player picks up the matching log, since players do not always collect leaves.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/oak_leaves.json}}</ref>
